method.description: Every chronology statement in the manuscript is mapped to Git-verifiable evidence: the commit that introduced it, its file, its commit timestamp, an evidence category, and whether retained outcomes already existed at that commit.
method.limitation: Git establishes commit ordering only. It cannot prove when a human inspected uncommitted files or when results were first observed outside Git.

key_commits.subject: Freeze PEVL protocol and validation tooling
Add PEVL manuscript and prospective validation results
Harden APS Open Science protocol article package

ordering_facts.fact: The frozen protocol commit is an ancestor of the retained-results commit.
ordering_facts.evidence: git merge-base --is-ancestor 803257f 23b9106 exits 0; commit timestamps differ by about 95 minutes on 2026-08-24.

statements.statement: The frozen case-study protocol already contained the eight-stage (eight-level) evidence ladder with binary gate consequences.
statements.evidence_detail: The frozen protocol enumerates levels 1-8 by name: artifact identity; seed-namespace integrity; schedule parity; identical-arm record parity; repeat and worker parity; stochastic-source audit; cross-arm event alignment; statistical admission. It prescribes binary consequences (preflight mismatch blocks acquisition; invalidating mismatch suppresses factorial contrasts).
statements.manuscript_must_say: the frozen protocol contained the full ladder and binary gates
statements.manuscript_must_not_say: that the named Level taxonomy as a whole was added after acquisition

statements.statement: The frozen plan prescribed finite-population paired resampling with 95% intervals and secondary exact two-sided McNemar inference conditional on gate passes.
statements.evidence_detail: '95% intervals use 100,000 paired resamples within each of the ten strata with seed 2026083117. Exact two-sided McNemar inference for the primary binary contrast.'

statements.statement: The frozen stress protocol promised public-package first-divergence positions, actors, and timing summaries as secondary endpoints.
statements.evidence_detail: 'the public package contains digests, first-divergence positions and actors, decision counts, terminal outcomes, errors, and timing summaries'; 'Secondary endpoints are first divergence position and acting side.'

statements.statement: Retained prospective result artifacts (preflight, stress, factorial) first appear in a descendant of the frozen protocol commit.
statements.evidence_detail: git log --diff-filter=A shows all four retained result files first added at 23b9106, after 803257f in ancestry.

statements.statement: The historical repeated-control audit rule and its suppression consequence were frozen retrospectively, after the historical outcomes already existed.
statements.evidence_detail: The historical files predate any current-protocol audit; the available-record gate was formulated for retrospective reanalysis of already-acquired records. The manuscript states this is not prospective blinding evidence.

statements.statement: The generic executable claim-class taxonomy, the conservative descriptive-only Level-6 reporting restriction, and the digest-plus-byte integrity extension were formalized after acquisition.
statements.evidence_detail: admission.py embeds created_after_acquisition=true and status=post_acquisition_executable_formalization; the bundle trust anchor pins these values. The byte-count extension appears only in closeout-era verifier code, not in the frozen endpoint text.
statements.manuscript_must_say: a post-acquisition conservative formalization and reusable template that future users must freeze before outcome acquisition
statements.manuscript_must_not_say: that the completed case prospectively validated the generic taxonomy

statements.statement: Acting-side first-divergence counts and per-profile timing summaries were recovered during closeout from the hash-pinned stress summary and added to the release as processed aggregates; first-divergence positions were never recorded.
statements.commit: closeout branch commit recovering D03 outputs
statements.evidence_detail: first_divergence_actor_counts={opponent: 99} and timing summaries exist in paper/data/pevl/timed_search_stress_summary.json (sha256 40b9f5e17a424742ad8a05739646fe56843b8f3a432b124bfc33f9aed1ab5a4b). No retained artifact contains position-level records; raw trace payloads remain restricted.

statements.statement: The Stage-6 machine-readable decision rules and Stage-4/5 certificate fields were added during closeout as documentation/verification infrastructure; they are not part of the frozen protocol and make no empirical claim.
statements.evidence_detail: Pure tooling: classifies audit inputs and exposes machine-checkable profile sets; no retained outcome changes.

prohibited_conclusions: Do not describe the historical repeated-control gate as prospectively blinded or preregistered.
Do not attribute the generic claim-class taxonomy or the descriptive-only Level-6 mapping to the frozen protocol commit.
Do not describe the byte-count integrity extension as the frozen primary endpoint (it is a post-acquisition extension; counts unchanged at 99/200).
Do not present recovered actor/timing aggregates as having been released at acquisition time.
